basic_info.description: Step into elegance with this exceptional Alamo Square Victorian! Upon entering this light filled flat, you’ll immediately notice the perfect balance between modern luxury and victorian era charm. Soaring 11 foot ceilings, a bay window and many period details make this the quintessential San Francisco home. This lower level unit, in a lovingly maintained duplex, was just remodeled with a brand new kitchen with an island, farmhouse sink, quartz counter tops and stainless steel appliances. The flat has hardwood floors throughout and updated bathrooms with spa-like Carrara marble and tile showers. Enjoy peaceful serenity in the beautifully landscaped shared backyard, with paver patio, artificial turf lawn and raised garden beds - a perfect place to BBQ, entertain and relax! Deeded one car parking in the garage and a shared parking space in the driveway. Deeded washer/dryer hookups in the garage. Located in the heart of San Francisco, between NOPA, Western Addition, Lower Pacific Heights, Hayes Valley, Haight-Ashbury and only 2 blocks from Alamo Square - home of the iconic painted ladies. With a walk score of 96, there are many great spots a short walk away including The Mill, Che Fico, The Independent, Brenda's Meat & Three, Nopa, and Bi-Rite Market. Both units are available!
